attempts.rationale: I want to test a robust weighted combination that favors lower-error models but still includes diversity; seasonality is strong and ranking unstable, so inverse_error weighting on the full pool is a good baseline.

decision.justification: Selected 'mean' (an agent proposal) as the best of 10 backtested attempts, score 1.0.
